scenario.title: 跟主管請假、同事給建議
scenario.context: 請病假要簡潔、有禮貌、交代工作。同事聽到你生病，會給各種建議：你應該去看醫生、最好多休息。should、had better、ought to 看起來都是「應該」，語氣卻差很多，用錯了可能變成在威脅人。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hi Karen, I'm afraid I need to call in sick today. I've had a fever since last night.
lines.zh: Karen 你好，我今天恐怕得請病假。我從昨晚開始發燒。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Oh no, sorry to hear that. Take it easy and get some rest.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Thanks. I've asked Daniel to cover the 2 p.m. client call.
lines.zh: 謝謝。我已經請 Daniel 幫我顧下午兩點的客戶電話。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Perfect. You should see a doctor if it doesn't go down.
lines.zh: 太好了。如果沒退燒，你應該去看醫生。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I will. I'll keep an eye on my email in case anything urgent comes up.
lines.zh: 我會的。我會留意信箱，以防有緊急的事。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Honestly, you'd better stay offline. We'll manage. Feel better!
lines.zh: 說真的，你最好別上線，我們撐得住。早日康復！

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Much better, thanks. It was just a bug, I think. Half my building has it.
lines.zh: 好多了，謝謝。應該只是小病毒，我們那棟一半的人都中了。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: You should've stayed home one more day. You still sound stuffy.
lines.zh: 你應該多待在家一天的，你聽起來還有鼻音。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I know, but I had a deadline.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Well, you ought to take it easy this week at least.
lines.zh: 嗯，至少這週你應該放慢一點。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I will. By the way, thanks for covering the call.
lines.zh: 我會的。對了，謝謝你幫我顧電話。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: No problem. Just don't play hooky on me next Friday!
lines.zh: 沒事。只要你下週五別給我裝病翹班就好！

patterns.en: I'm afraid I need to call in sick today.
patterns.note: I'm afraid 讓壞消息聽起來比較客氣

patterns.en: I've had a fever since last night.
I'll be checking my email occasionally.

chinglish.wrong: I want to ask for a leave today.
chinglish.right: I need to take a sick day today. / I'm calling in sick today.
chinglish.why: ask for a leave 是中式直翻，而且 leave 在這裡不可數，不加 a。病假說 take a sick day 或 call in sick。

chinglish.wrong: You had better go see a doctor, OK?
chinglish.right: You should really see a doctor.
chinglish.why: had better 語氣很重，帶「不然會有後果」的暗示，對平輩或上司說聽起來像命令甚至威脅。一般建議用 should。

chinglish.wrong: I am sick, so I cannot go to the company.
chinglish.right: I'm sick, so I can't come in today.
chinglish.why: 「去公司」直翻成 go to the company 很生硬。上班說 come in / go into the office / go to work。
should 後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to。ought 才要加 to。

grammar.title: should / had better / ought to
grammar.oneLiner: should 是一般建議；ought to 意思差不多但稍微正式；had better 是強烈警告，暗示不照做會有後果。
whenToUse: should + 原形：最常用、語氣中性的建議。You should get some rest.
ought to + 原形：和 should 差不多，稍微正式或強調「道理上應該」。口語較少用。
had better（'d better）+ 原形：強烈建議，暗示「不然會出事」。You'd better leave now or you'll miss the train.
had better 雖然有 had，但講的是現在或未來，不是過去。
否定：shouldn't / had better not（不是 hadn't better）。
過去後悔：should have + p.p.（第 49 單元會詳細講）。You should've stayed home.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的「應該、最好、要」語氣差別不大，「你最好去看醫生」聽起來很關心。但英文的 had better 帶有警告意味，接近「你最好給我去看醫生，不然…」。課本常把 had better 翻成「最好」，台灣人就拿它當禮貌建議用，結果對主管說了很沒禮貌的話。

examples.correct: We'd better hurry. The meeting starts in five minutes.
examples.note: 有後果（遲到），用 had better 很自然，而且對象是「我們」。

examples.correct: You shouldn't work when you're sick.
examples.incorrect: You don't should work when you're sick.

examples.correct: You'd better not tell the boss.
examples.incorrect: You hadn't better tell the boss.
examples.note: had better 的否定是 had better not。

examples.correct: You ought to call your mom more often.
examples.note: ought to 常帶「道理上、道德上應該」的語感。

quiz.question: Your coworker has a bad cough. The most polite advice is:
options: You should probably see a doctor.
quiz.explanation: 一般的關心建議用 should，加 probably 更柔和。

quiz.question: It's 8:55 and the train leaves at 9. "We ___ run!"
quiz.explanation: 有明確後果（趕不上車），用 had better。

quiz.question: You should ___ (rest) for a few days.
Which is correct?
quiz.explanation: had better 的否定是 had better not。

quiz.question: You ___ to apologize to her. It was your fault. (應該，用 ought)

slang.meaning: 打電話（或傳訊息）請病假
slang.usage: 當天通知公司自己生病不能上班。

risk.note: 職場標準說法，可以直接對主管用。

examples.en: Three people called in sick today, so we're short-staffed.
examples.zh: 今天有三個人請病假，所以人手不足。

examples.en: I hate calling in sick, but I can barely stand up.
examples.zh: 我很討厭請病假，但我連站都站不太起來。

slang.meaning: 放輕鬆、別太累；也用來道別
slang.usage: 叫人休息別勉強，或是朋友間道別：Take it easy!（保重、慢走）。

risk.note: 對方在生氣時說 Take it easy! 會變成「你冷靜點」，可能火上加油。

examples.en: You just got over the flu. Take it easy this week.
examples.zh: 你剛好流感，這週放慢一點。

examples.en: See you tomorrow. Take it easy!

slang.meaning: 小病毒、小感冒（傳染性的小病）
slang.usage: a stomach bug（腸胃炎）、there's a bug going around（最近有病毒在流行）。

risk.note: 很常用。注意程式的 bug 是「錯誤」，看語境判斷。

examples.en: There's a bug going around the office.
examples.zh: 辦公室最近有病毒在流行。

examples.en: I caught a stomach bug on my trip.

slang.usage: 沒有正當理由地不去上學或上班，常帶玩笑語氣。

risk.note: 開玩笑可以；認真指控同事 play hooky 很嚴重。有點老派但仍通用。

examples.en: We played hooky and went to the beach.
It's such a nice day. Want to play hooky this afternoon?
examples.zh: 天氣這麼好，下午要不要翹班？

review.question: I'm staying at my ___ place this weekend.
review.explanation: 複習第 16 單元：複數 parents 只加 '。

review.question: Which is correct?
review.explanation: 複習第 15 單元：be 動詞後放頻率副詞。

review.question: Sorry, I'm ___ (confuse). Can you explain that again?
review.explanation: 複習第 13 單元：感受用 -ed。

review.question: Sorry, I have to ___. Something came up at work.
review.explanation: 複習第 9 單元：bail = 取消、先閃。

review.question: A: Sorry I'm late! B: No ___, we just started.
Which advice sounds the most like a warning?
